q2_gaps: A non-deictic season as a time value ('in the winter of Year 1'): the Time term constructors are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, bare symbols cover day-parts and DEICTIC seasons ('last_spring'), but nothing states how a plain season is encoded or how it composes with a stated year.
notes: 'briefly' correctly takes `(Duration <event> briefly)` rather than Manner, 'Cauldron Hall' follows the Kestrel-River pattern (one name symbol + separate `hall` type atom), and no kind atom is invented for Coraline Ash.
